verdict.rationale: PostHog is open-source (MIT-licensed self-host Docker Compose) and exposes data via SQL, an HTTP API, and data-warehouse sync, which together give strong data portability and self-hosting options implying users can retain full control of their data. However, there is no explicit documented 'export all your data' feature or open-format bulk export tool, and no independent evidence of someone successfully exporting/migrating a full production dataset. Missing for 10: explicit bulk-export/download-all-data documentation, confirmation of open standard export formats (e.g., CSV/Parquet dumps), and independent hands-on evidence of a full data migration/exit.
